claim: Neither French FL entity (Foot Locker France SAS 382401867; FL France Holdings SAS 480023324) has deposited its CY2025 statutory accounts. Infogreffe lists a 'Certificat de non-depot' for the 2025-12-31 year end (record updated 2026-09-06), and a Nanterre court order dated 2026-07-06 (deposits 2026/32078 and 2026/32076, filed 2026-07-09) extended the deadline for the meeting that approves the accounts. No confidentiality election lodged so far.
data_point: Deposit history FL France SAS: FY2024 accounts deposited 2025-07-26 (no 2025 extension), 'confidentialite: PUBLICS'; FY2025 not deposited as of 2026-10-07; court extensions routine 2019-2024 (orders 22/07/2019, 19/11/2019, 17/12/2020, 02/07/2021, 01/08/2022, 02/06/2023, 03/07/2024).
source_name: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce de Nanterre via Infogreffe catalogue API; corroborated by recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr and Le Figaro Entreprises act list
original_quote: Ordonnance - Prorogation du delai de reunion de l'A.G. chargee d'approuver les comptes ; Certificat de non-depot (date_cloture 2025-12-31)
english_translation: Court order extending the deadline for the shareholders' meeting that approves the accounts; certificate of non-filing for the year ended 2025-12-31
verifier_note: Live Infogreffe API and infogreffe.fr return HTTP 403 to the verifier; verified from the scraper's saved API JSON (both entities: ordonnance date 2026-07-06, id_ged 219885214/219885213, depots 2026/32078 and 2026/32076 dated 2026-07-09, COMPTES_NON_DEPOSES with date_cloture 2025-12-31 updated 2026-09-06, FY2024 depots 2025/41539 and 2025/41593 'PUBLICS'). Independent corroboration: recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr (fetched 2026-10-07) still shows only 2024 finances (CA EUR 394,852,936). Le Figaro act list confirms extensions were routine every year 2019-2024, so this is a watch item, not a signal in itself. Downgraded A->B. Wave 1 already knew the CY2025 accounts were unpublished; the court order and non-deposit record are new.

claim: The act deposited 11/08/2025 for both French FL entities records that Tomas Conny Petersson resigned, effective 2025-08-06, as the individual permanent representative of Foot Locker Europe B.V. (the corporate President). No replacement representative was named; Foot Locker Europe B.V. (Stationsplein 32, Utrecht) acts through its director Gozde Sen Lonell. Filing formalities are handled by Citco France SARL and Citco Mercator UAB.
data_point: Two-item agenda (resignation; powers for formalities); Petersson owed no sums; KPMG SA auditor absent; Docusign envelope 92996CF8-D3FD-49AB-BA75-BF85EEC6E483; INPI pieces 36920833 / 36902673. No share transfer, contribution, statute change or dissolution in the act.
original_quote: Prend acte de la demission de Monsieur Tomas Conny Petersson de son mandat de representant permanent personne physique de la societe FOOT LOCKER EUROPE B.V. ; elle-meme President de la Societe, a compter du 6 aout 2025
english_translation: Takes note of the resignation of Mr Tomas Conny Petersson as individual permanent representative of Foot Locker Europe B.V., itself President of the Company, effective 6 August 2025
verifier_note: Quote verified word for word in the locally saved PDFs of both actes (data.inpi.fr is Cloudflare-protected to scripts). Low novelty: Petersson's Aug-2025 exit from FL Europe statutory seats is already confirmed for the UK (1 Aug 2025), Belgium, Spain and Switzerland, and Sen Lonell as FL Europe B.V. director at Stationsplein 32 is already in confirmed files (she has since left, June 2026). Only the French instance and the Citco outsourcing are new. Downgraded A->C.

claim: The 13 Apr 2026 sole-shareholder decisions for Foot Locker France SAS (same text for FL France Holdings SAS) include a third decision not shown in BODACC, titled 'confirmation of treasury procedures': opening bank accounts, borrowing agreements and any mortgage, charge or other security over the company's business or assets may only be signed by two Directeurs generaux (Matthew Campbell Barnes and Erik Jan Amperse). Both serve without pay for the office.
data_point: Barnes: British, b. 1973-05-07 Bath (= Matthew Barnes, President FL International). Amperse: Dutch, b. 1966-09-08 Dordrecht. Both 'ne percevra aucune remuneration au titre de ce mandat'. Closing/maintaining accounts may be done by two DGs or one DG plus an authorised signatory. Signed for the sole shareholder via Foot Locker Europe B.V. by Gozde Sen Lonell. Docusign 16FE1C75-34C3-4C9C-968A-4ED6B601387E; INPI piece 39178245.
source_name: INPI RNE acte (bilingual extract of minutes)
original_quote: tous les accords et autres documents relatifs aux emprunts contractes par la Societe ou a toute hypotheque, charge ou autre surete sur tout ou partie de l'activite, des biens et des actifs de la Societe, ne peuvent etre signes que par deux Directeurs Generaux
english_translation: all agreements relating to the lending of money to the Company or to any mortgage, charge or other security over the whole or any part of the Company's undertaking, property and assets shall only be signed by two General Managers
verifier_note: Text verified in the locally saved PDF. The act frames this as reconfirming existing treasury procedures ('L'Associe Unique souhaite reconfirmer les procedures de tresorerie') for the newly appointed DGs. That is standard post-appointment signing policy, not a new tightening, so the scraper's 'now require' framing is overstated. Appointments are already known (wave-1 BODACC). Downgraded A->C.

claim: INSEE SIRENE national stock of 1 Oct 2026: still no Foot Locker France establishment closures or creations dated 2026. CY2025 had 9 gross closures (one is the Rouen St-Sever relocation) and 2 creations. 145 of 215 SIRETs are active. The latest INSEE processing of any FL France establishment is 2026-06-03, so closures confirmed by press and the locator after Sept 2025 (e.g. Avignon Marchands 00074, Paris 66 Rivoli 01833, Mulhouse 00850) are still shown as Actif.
data_point: Closures by year (open closed periods): 2022 7, 2023 9, 2024 7, 2025 9, 2026 0; creations 2025 2, 2026 0. Last-processing dates of 2025 closures: 2025-09-13 batch 2025-12-05/06 (Aubervilliers, Marseille Bourse, also Paris Fbg St-Antoine closed 2025-08-02), Lille Euralille Kids (closed 2025-08-16) 2026-02-26, Strasbourg (closed 2025-09-13) 2026-03-17. Active-unit staffing bands (INSEE codes): 60 units 6-9 staff (03), 49 units 10-19 (11), 20 units 20-49 (12), 9 units 3-5 (02), 6 n/a, 1 50-99.
source_name: INSEE SIRENE StockEtablissement + StockEtablissementHistorique, 01 Oct 2026 (data.gouv.fr); verifier re-ran the DuckDB queries
verifier_note: All counts and SIRET statuses reproduced by the verifier from the live 1-Oct-2026 parquet files. Corrections: (1) the scraper misread the staffing codes: code 03 is 6-9 staff, not 3-5, and code 02 is 3-5, not 1-2. (2) The 'registration lag' uses dateDernierTraitementEtablissement, which is the LAST processing date, not the first; it is an upper bound and the 12-28 week figure is approximate. Largely overlaps the wave-1 confirmed SIRENE item (no 2026 registrations, the 2025-09-13 batch, Avignon still Actif). New: the Oct-2026 refresh, and that INSEE has not processed any FL France establishment since 2026-06-03. Downgraded A->C.

claim: The INSEE succession-link file (1 Oct 2026) shows no Foot Locker France SIRET handed to another company's SIREN, and no link at all dated after 2023-06-30. There are 22 links (1993-2023); third-party predecessors date from FL's 2001 acquisitions; later links are internal relocations.
data_point: 22 links; last 38240186700140 -> 38240186702021 on 2023-06-30; every link's dateDernierTraitementLienSuccession = 2024-03-22.
source_name: INSEE StockEtablissementLiensSuccession 01 Oct 2026 (verifier re-ran the query)
verifier_note: Data reproduced exactly (22 links). The test is weak, though: all links were last processed 2024-03-22, and the Feb-2025 Rouen St-Sever relocation (00827 -> new SIRET 02153) has no link in the file, so the file does not reliably capture even internal moves since 2024. Also, not every post-2001 link has economic continuity (2020-06-24 00231 -> 01841 is flagged false). The absence of a successor link is weak evidence that no stores were transferred. The name-search part (no new Foot Locker/Dick's French entity apart from FOOT LOCKER CANADA CO) was not re-run. Downgraded A->C.
